verses.text: Now, O daughter of troops, mobilize your troops; for a siege is laid against us! With a rod they will strike the cheek of the judge of Israel.

xrefs.text: Let him offer his cheek to the one who would strike him; let him be filled with reproach.
When Jesus had said this, one of the officers standing nearby slapped Him in the face and said, “Is this how You answer the high priest?
Then they spit in His face and struck Him. Others slapped Him
And they went up to Him again and again, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews! and slapping Him in the face.
For the LORD is our Judge, the LORD is our lawgiver, the LORD is our King. It is He who will save us.

verses.text: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, who are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come forth for Me One to be ruler over Israel One whose origins are of old, from the days of eternity.

xrefs.text: ‘But you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah, for out of you will come a ruler who will be the shepherd of My people Israel.’
Doesn’t the Scripture say that the Christ will come from the line of David and from Bethlehem, the village where David lived?
Behold, you will conceive and give birth to a son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus.
For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given, and the government will be upon His shoulders. And He will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
Before the mountains were born or You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.

verses.text: Therefore Israel will be abandoned until she who is in labor has given birth; then the rest of His brothers will return to the children of Israel.

xrefs.text: And a great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed in the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head.
She will give birth to a Son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus, because He will save His people from their sins.
And I will make the lame into a remnant, the outcast into a strong nation. Then the LORD will rule over them in Mount Zion from that day and forever.
Isaiah cries out concerning Israel: “Though the number of the Israelites is like the sand of the sea, only the remnant will be saved.
On that day the remnant of Israel and the survivors of the house of Jacob will no longer depend on him who struck them, but they will truly rely on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel.

verses.text: He will stand and shepherd His flock in the strength of the LORD, in the majestic name of the LORD His God. And they will dwell securely, for then His greatness will extend to the ends of the earth.

xrefs.text: Behold, the Lord GOD comes with might, and His arm establishes His rule. His reward is with Him, and His recompense accompanies Him.
A Psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
Shepherd with Your staff Your people, the flock of Your inheritance. They live alone in a woodland, surrounded by pastures. Let them graze in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David,
who through faith are shielded by God’s power for the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.

verses.text: And He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land and tramples our citadels. We will raise against it seven shepherds, even eight leaders of men.

xrefs.text: “Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace to men on whom His favor rests!
Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.
“My anger burns against the shepherds, and I will punish the leaders. For the LORD of Hosts attends to His flock, the house of Judah; He will make them like His royal steed in battle.
and through Him to reconcile to Himself all things, whether things on earth or things in heaven, by making peace through the blood of His cross.
For He Himself is our peace, who has made the two one and has torn down the dividing wall of hostility

verses.text: And they will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod with the blade drawn. So He will deliver us when Assyria invades our land and marches into our borders.

xrefs.text: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who began to be a mighty one on the earth.
deliverance from hostile hands, that we may serve Him without fear,
I will break Assyria in My land; I will trample him on My mountain. His yoke will be taken off My people, and his burden removed from their shoulders.”
So this is what the LORD says about the king of Assyria: ‘He will not enter this city or shoot an arrow into it. He will not come before it with a shield or build up a siege ramp against it.
Woe to you, O destroyer never destroyed, O traitor never betrayed! When you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed. When you have finished betraying, you will be betrayed.

verses.text: Then the remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which do not wait for man or linger for mankind.

xrefs.text: May he be like rain that falls on freshly cut grass, like spring showers that water the earth.
For I will pour water on the thirsty land, and currents on the dry ground. I will pour out My Spirit on your descendants, and My blessing on your offspring.
Therefore Israel will be abandoned until she who is in labor has given birth; then the rest of His brothers will return to the children of Israel.
I will be like the dew to Israel; he will blossom like the lily and take root like the cedars of Lebanon.
Let my teaching fall like rain and my speech settle like dew, like gentle rain on new grass, like showers on tender plants.

verses.text: Then the remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the beasts of the forest, like a young lion among flocks of sheep, which tramples and tears as it passes through, with no one to rescue them.

xrefs.text: They will be like mighty men in battle, trampling the enemy in the mire of the streets. They will fight because the LORD is with them, and they will put the horsemen to shame.

Rise and thresh, O Daughter of Zion, for I will give you horns of iron and hooves of bronze to break to pieces many peoples. Then you will devote their gain to the LORD, their wealth to the Lord of all the earth.
On that day, when all the nations of the earth gather against her, I will make Jerusalem a heavy stone for all the peoples; all who would heave it away will be severely injured.
Ask Me, and I will make the nations Your inheritance, the ends of the earth Your possession.

The LORD of Hosts will shield them. They will destroy and conquer with slingstones; they will drink and roar as with wine. And they will be filled like sprinkling bowls, drenched like the corners of the altar.

verses.text: Your hand will be lifted over your foes, and all your enemies will be cut off.

xrefs.text: Your hand will apprehend all Your enemies; Your right hand will seize those who hate You.
O LORD, Your hand is upraised, but they do not see it. They will see Your zeal for Your people and be put to shame. The fire set for Your enemies will consume them!

The nations will escort Israel and bring it to its homeland. Then the house of Israel will possess the nations as menservants and maidservants in the LORD’s land. They will make captives of their captors and rule over their oppressors.
Arise, O LORD! Lift up Your hand, O God! Do not forget the helpless.

They will swoop down on the slopes of the Philistines to the west; together they will plunder the sons of the east. They will lay their hands on Edom and Moab, and the Ammonites will be subject to them.

verses.text: “In that day,” declares the LORD, “I will remove your horses from among you and wreck your chariots.

xrefs.text: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem, and the bow of war will be broken. Then He will proclaim peace to the nations. His dominion will extend from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.
Assyria will not save us, nor will we ride on horses. We will never again say, ‘Our gods!’ to the work of our own hands. For in You the fatherless find compassion.”
Some trust in chariots and others in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
No king is saved by his vast army; no warrior is delivered by his great strength.
Their land is full of silver and gold, with no limit to their treasures; their land is full of horses, with no limit to their chariots.

verses.text: I will remove the cities of your land and tear down all your strongholds.

xrefs.text: For the Day of the LORD of Hosts will come against all the proud and lofty, against all that is exalted— it will be humbled—

the roar of battle will rise against your people, so that all your fortresses will be demolished as Shalman devastated Beth-arbel in the day of battle, when mothers were dashed to pieces along with their children.
You will say, ‘I will go up against a land of unwalled villages; I will come against a quiet people who dwell securely, all of them living without walls or bars or gates—
He flashes destruction on the strong, so that fury comes upon the stronghold.
So he said to me, “This is the word of the LORD to Zerubbabel: Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit, says the LORD of Hosts.

verses.text: I will cut the sorceries from your hand, and you will have no fortune-tellers.

xrefs.text: Let no one be found among you who sacrifices his son or daughter in the fire, practices divination or conjury, interprets omens, practices sorcery,
When men tell you to consult mediums and spiritists who whisper and mutter, shouldn’t a people consult their God instead? Why consult the dead on behalf of the living?
But outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
In that day men will cast away to the moles and bats their idols of silver and gold— the idols they made to worship.

But the beast was captured along with the false prophet, who on its behalf had performed signs deceiving those who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image. Both the beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into the fiery lake of burning sulfur.

verses.text: I will also cut off the carved images and sacred pillars from among you, so that you will no longer bow down to the work of your own hands.

xrefs.text: Then in the nations to which they have been carried captive, your survivors will remember Me— how I have been grieved by their adulterous hearts that turned away from Me, and by their eyes that lusted after idols. So they will loathe themselves for the evil they have done and for all their abominations.
I will also sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your impurities and all your idols.

They will no longer defile themselves with their idols or detestable images, or with any of their transgressions. I will save them from all their apostasies by which they sinned, and I will cleanse them. Then they will be My people, and I will be their God.
Assyria will not save us, nor will we ride on horses. We will never again say, ‘Our gods!’ to the work of our own hands. For in You the fatherless find compassion.”

And on that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, I will erase the names of the idols from the land, and they will no longer be remembered. I will also remove the prophets and the spirit of impurity from the land.

verses.text: I will root out the Asherah poles from your midst and demolish your cities.

xrefs.text: Rather, you must tear down their altars, smash their sacred stones, and chop down their Asherah poles.

verses.text: I will take vengeance in anger and wrath upon the nations that have not obeyed Me.”

I will destine you for the sword, and you will all kneel down to be slaughtered, because I called and you did not answer, I spoke and you did not listen; you did evil in My sight and chose that in which I did not delight.”
